one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-14 to 2026-11-13. (1) Q3-2026 results: not yet announced, but IonQ announced Q3-2025 results on 2025-10-14 for 2025-11-05 and Q2-2026 on 2026-07-24 for 2026-08-05, so a report around Nov 4-5 is very likely inside the window. First quarter with SkyWater: revenue jumps, GAAP loss and warrant marks swing. (2) Settlement of the $2.0B offering on ~2026-10-16 (424B5) at $40 per share with two Series C warrants: new holders may hedge or sell. (3) Elisity closing (outside date 2027-01-07; ~34.8M shares at the floor). Base rate: after the comparable Oct-2025 raise at $93 the stock fell to $49.30 by end-November 2025. Against that, IONQ is near the bottom of its 52-week range after a sharp fall, where short-horizon reversal is common, and the DARPA Stage C news is fresh. Net: slight negative drift (median ~$31) at roughly the stock's usual monthly vol (92%/3.5 = 26%; I use 25% lognormal). Unchanged from round 1: the supervisor's findings concern value, not the 1-month window.

fair_value.method: Weighted at the 2027-10-14 horizon on 534.4M share-equivalents (SBC as dilution), horizon net cash $3,200M, units $2,052M and warrant claims solved per state: (a) rNPV $10.35 x 0.30 + (b) TAM $10.58 x 0.20 + (e) floor + option $10.02 x 0.20 + (f) Quantinuum mark $19.95 x 0.20 + (d) SOTP at cost $12.19 x 0.10 = 3.105 + 2.116 + 2.004 + 3.990 + 1.219 = $12.43. Reverse DCF weight 0; peer EV/sales dropped to weight 0 (its revenue path rested on an unverified consensus).

methods.name: other: (a) milestone rNPV on IonQ's roadmap
methods.inputs: Equity per state = net cash $3,200M + units $2,052M + computing (gross PV at horizon less development spend incl. SBC) - warrant claim, / 534.4M. Gross: A 57,000 x 25% x 25% x 0.79 x 15.3x / 1.15^8.2 = $13,678M; B (2037, $64B x 15% x 20%) $5,578M; C 6% x 15% $1,970M; D 2% x 5% $219M; E 0. Net computing: A $11,078M, B $2,178M, C -$630M, D -$981M, E -$1,000M. Per share after warrants: A $26.67, B $12.65, C $8.05, D $7.46, E $7.43. Weighted 0.13/0.06/0.15/0.26/0.40 = $10.35 (expected computing $0.82B).

inputs_detail.value: A on-time winner 0.13 / B late winner 0.06 / C contender 0.15 / D niche 0.26 / E failure 0.40
inputs_detail.derivation: Kalshi: useful QC before 2030 33%, before 2035 48%; IonQ one of six first-cohort DARPA QBI Stage C teams across five modalities; ~40% chance of a top-2 position if the field succeeds: 0.33 x 0.4 = 0.13 on time, (0.48-0.33) x 0.4 = 0.06 late. McKinsey QTM 2026 as summarised by PostQuantum (one secondary source; McKinsey page returned 503).

reverse_dcf_check: Today: 517.2M share-equivalents (408.91M + 50.0M offering incl. pre-funded + 34.78M Elisity at the $33.07 floor + 3.02M retention RSUs + 20.46M existing awards) x $31.545 = $16,314M; plus warrants at spot ~$2,639M (Black-Scholes, 75% vol); less net cash $3,806M and units $2,052M leaves ~$13.1B for computing. Compounded at 15% to end-2035 plus ~$2.6B of further spend incl. SBC, the 2035 computing franchise must be worth ~$55B: NOPAT ~$3.6B at 15.3x, or ~$18.3B revenue at a 25% EBIT margin, ~32% of McKinsey's $57B midpoint, held with certainty. Base rates (Kalshi useful QC before 2035 48%; IonQ a top-2 winner in ~40% of those worlds) give success odds near 0.19, so the market prices a TAM several times McKinsey's, a much lower discount rate or near-certain leadership. Company guidance covers only FY2026 revenue ($450-460M) and does not bridge the gap. Value view: fundamental fair value $12.43; only part of the gap closes in 12 months (ladder median ~$23.5). The engine's implied-WACC print is not meaningful: DCF and multiple legs carry weight 0 and FCFF is negative through FY2030.

sbc_treatment.note: FY2025 SBC $312.0M (F43); TTM $450.0M (F46). Revised from round 1 (costed): SBC is now counted once, as dilution, to the horizon: 20.46M existing unvested awards (424B5), 3.02M Elisity retention RSUs and 15.0M new grants (TTM SBC / spot) are in the 534.4M share-equivalents, and cash burn (operating cash flow + capex) excludes SBC. After the horizon, SBC is carried as development spend in each state's PV, since those shares are not in the count. Peer sales multiples are SBC-neutral.

reasoning: Base rates first (my lane). IONQ's monthly history 2021-26: annualized vol ~97%, max drawdown -86% (2021-22); over 58 overlapping 12-month windows the median return was +35%, but 17% of windows lost more than half and 34% more than doubled, a sample dominated by the 2023-25 quantum rally. The stock fell after each prior Heights-style raise. Field odds from prediction markets: Kalshi useful QC before 2030 33%, before 2035 48%, before 2040 58%; Manifold Q-Day before 2030 17.6%. Round 2 changes (supervisor findings, re-checked at the filings): share count now 534.4M share-equivalents with SBC counted once as dilution (424B5 for the 408.9M base, the 50M offered shares and pre-funded warrants and 22.8M existing awards at 6/30; Elisity 8-K for 34.8M closing shares, earnout and $100M retention RSUs); net cash $3.81B now and $3.20B at the horizon on a cash basis that excludes SBC and includes interest income (Q2 interest income $32.0M); the unverified Investor Day intercompany figure and Yahoo consensus are gone: SkyWater's external revenue (~$410M/yr) now comes from IonQ's own guidance change ($280-290M ex-SkyWater to $450-460M with SkyWater from 7/31 after intercompany elimination); post-horizon SBC is in development spend. I keep units at $2.05B (below the supervisor's $2.45B) because the company's own guidance implies ~$410M, not ~$600M, of external SkyWater revenue. Five methods give $10.02-19.95; fair value $12.43 (round 1 $13.99). Reverse DCF: the market needs ~32% of the 2035 computing market with certainty. Ladder: quantum premiums persist (QNT, RGTI, QBTS at 150-330x sales), so only part of the gap to fair value closes in 12 months: scenario mixture bear $14 p0.35 / base $26 p0.45 / bull $58 p0.20 with 40-45% within-scenario vol gives median ~$23.5, mean ~$30.8, P(close >= $31.545) ~0.33. Defense/government revenue: the Q2 release says ~60% of revenue is commercial (non-U.S.-government enterprise and universities), so up to ~40% of IonQ standalone revenue is U.S. government; the defense/intelligence subset (AFRL, DARPA and others) is not disclosed, and SkyWater's DoD trusted-foundry work may raise the combined share. Research limits: sec.gov refused a generic user agent, so filings were read with WebFetch; X/Twitter not used; McKinsey's own page returned 503.
